### Data processing

```{r}
#counts <- read_table("data/counts_kb_trim_multi", col_names = T) # Load data 
counts <- read.csv("data/counts_kb_trim_multi.csv", header = T)


geneSymbols <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                                     keys=counts$gene, 
                                     column="SYMBOL", 
                                     keytype="ENSEMBL", 
                                     multiVals="first")
geneSymbols <- as.data.frame(geneSymbols)
counts$gene_id <- geneSymbols$geneSymbols


# Calculate library sizes (total counts per sample)
lib_sizes <- colSums(counts[,2:19])

# CPM calculation
cpm <- as.data.frame(t(t(counts[,2:19]) / lib_sizes) * 1e6)
#cpm <- as.data.frame(cpm(counts[,2:19], log = TRUE, prior.count = 1))
cpm$gene_id <- counts$gene_id

#pm <- cpm[, !names(cpm) %in% "gene_id"] # Remove ensembl IDs from data frame
cpm <- na.omit(cpm) #Remove the genes without official GeneID
cpm <- cpm[!duplicated(cpm$gene_id), ]
rownames(cpm) <- NULL
cpm <- cpm[!duplicated(cpm$gene_id), ]
cpm <- column_to_rownames(cpm, var = "gene_id")
cpm <- cpm[rowSums(cpm >=5) >= 4, ]
#filtered_counts <- filtered_counts[rowSums(filtered_counts > 5) == ncol(filtered_counts), ]
cpm[] <- lapply(cpm, as.numeric)




feature_table_genes <- read.csv("data/Features_genes.csv")
feature_table_genes_2 <- as.data.frame(feature_table_genes$external_gene_name) #extract only gene names from file
colnames(feature_table_genes_2) <- "gene_name" 


#Add length to dataframe, and make it kbps
feature_table_genes_2$length <- (feature_table_genes$transcript_length/1000)  #transcript length is in bps
lengths_vector <- setNames(feature_table_genes_2$length, feature_table_genes_2$gene_name) # Create a named vector of lengths for quick lookup
common_ids <- intersect(counts$gene_id, names(lengths_vector)) # Identify common IDs



counts <- counts[, !names(counts) %in% "gene"] # Remove ensembl IDs from data frame
counts <- na.omit(counts) #Remove the genes without official GeneID
filtered_counts <- counts[!duplicated(counts$gene_id), ]
rownames(filtered_counts) <- NULL
filtered_counts <- column_to_rownames(filtered_counts, var = "gene_id")
filtered_counts <- round(filtered_counts, digits = 0) # Round the integers because of the multimapping

#filtered_counts_hist <- pivot_longer(filtered_counts, cols = c(1:18), names_to = "sample", values_to = "counts")
filtered_counts_hist <- rowSums(filtered_counts)
hist(filtered_counts_hist, breaks = 200000, xlim = c(0, 500), ylim = c(0, 100))

filtered_counts <- filtered_counts[rowSums(filtered_counts >=10) >= 2, ]

#filtered_counts <- filtered_counts[rowSums(filtered_counts > 5) == ncol(filtered_counts), ]
filtered_counts[] <- lapply(filtered_counts, as.numeric)
```

```{r}
# Create DESeq2 dataset
condition <- factor(c("Control", "Control", "Estradiol 10 nM", "Estradiol 10 nM", "Estradiol 20 nM", "Estradiol 20 nM", "Estradiol 40 nM", "Estradiol 40 nM", "Estradiol 80 nM", "Estradiol 80 nM", "Tamoxifen 10 nM", "Tamoxifen 10 nM", "Tamoxifen 20 nM", "Tamoxifen 20 nM", "Tamoxifen 40 nM", "Tamoxifen 40 nM", "Tamoxifen 80 nM", "Tamoxifen 80 nM"))
colData <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(filtered_counts))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = filtered_counts, colData = colData, design = ~condition)
#dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Variance stabilizing transformation (better for PCA)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Extract transformed values
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)

# Check first few rows
head(pca_data)

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of RNA-seq Data", x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```

```{r fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}
# Create DESeq2 dataset
condition <- factor(c("Control", "Control", "Estradiol (10 nM)", "Estradiol (10 nM)", "Estradiol (20 nM)", "Estradiol (20 nM)", "Estradiol (40 nM)", "Estradiol (40 nM)", "Estradiol (80 nM)", "Estradiol (80 nM)", "Tamoxifen (10 nM)", "Tamoxifen (10 nM)", "Tamoxifen (20 nM)", "Tamoxifen (20 nM)", "Tamoxifen (40 nM)", "Tamoxifen (40 nM)", "Tamoxifen (80 nM)", "Tamoxifen (80 nM)"))

colData <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(filtered_counts))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = filtered_counts, colData = colData, design = ~condition)

# Variance stabilizing transformation
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Extract PCA data
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)

# Calculate variance explained
pca <- prcomp(t(assay(vsd)))
percentVar <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1)
pca_data$Treatment <- c(rep("Control", 2), rep("Estradiol", 8), rep("Tamoxifen", 8))
# Plot
ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey10" ,"olivedrab1", "limegreen", "seagreen4", "darkgreen", "orange1", "darkorange3", "orangered3", "darkred"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 16, 16)) +  
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of RNA-seq data Estrogen inhibition and activation",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "% variance)")
  )

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey10" ,"olivedrab1", "limegreen", "seagreen4", "darkgreen", "orange1", "darkorange3", "orangered3", "darkred"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 16, 16)) +  
  theme_classic() +
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+
  labs(
    #title = "PCA of RNA-seq data Estrogen inhibition and activation",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "% variance)")
  )
```

```{r}
progeny_model$VIRMA <- ifelse(progeny_model$gene %in% VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x, "yes", "no")
```

# Volcano plots

```{r fig.width = 5, fig.height= 5}
counts_high <- filtered_counts[,c(7, 8, 9, 10, 15, 16, 17, 18)]
#counts_high <- counts_high[(rowSums(counts_high >= 5) >= 2), ]


condition <- factor(c("Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Tamoxifen", "Tamoxifen", "Tamoxifen", "Tamoxifen"))

colData <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(counts_high))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_high, colData = colData, design = ~condition)
#dds <- DESeq(dds)


dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

# Order by adjusted p-value
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
#Add a column to label significance
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$significant <- ifelse(res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, "yes", "no")
res_df$VIRMA <- ifelse(rownames(res_df) %in% VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x, "yes", "no")
res_df$downregulated_blastoid <- ifelse(rownames(res_df) %in% up_blastocyst & rownames(res_df) %in% VIRMA_targets$x, "yes", "no")
res_df$Estrogen <- ifelse(rownames(res_df) %in% progeny_model_estrogen_signif_pos$gene, "yes", "no")
res_df["VIRMA", "VIRMA"] <- "VIRMA"
res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$VIRMA), ]
res_df_significant_high <- res_df[res_df$significant == "yes",]
res_df_high <- res_df

res_df_switch <- res_df
res_df_switch$log2FoldChange <- (res_df_switch$log2FoldChange*-1)


# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "grey", "yes" = "goldenrod1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, -0.5), col = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-log10(0.05)),  col = "grey")+
  NoLegend()+
  xlim(-4, 4)+
  labs(title = "Tamoxifen/Estrogen", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value")

# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = VIRMA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "grey", "yes" = "coral")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_point(data = res_df["VIRMA", , drop = FALSE], color = "cornflowerblue", size = 3)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, -0.5), col = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-log10(0.05)),  col = "grey")+
  NoLegend()+
  xlim(-4, 4)+
  labs(title = "Tamoxifen/Estrogen", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value")

  
res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$downregulated_blastoid), ]  
# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = downregulated_blastoid)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "grey", "yes" = "darkslateblue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, -0.5), col = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-log10(0.05)),  col = "grey")+
  NoLegend()+
  xlim(-4, 4)+
  labs(title = "Tamoxifen/Estrogen", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value")
 


res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$Estrogen), ]  
# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Estrogen)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "grey", "yes" = "goldenrod1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, -0.5), col = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-log10(0.05)),  col = "grey")+
  NoLegend()+
  xlim(-4, 4)+
  labs(title = "Tamoxifen/Estrogen", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value")
  
# Filter rows where 'significant' column equals 'yes'
yes_rows <- res_df_significant_high[res_df_significant_high$significant == "yes", ]
yes_rows <- yes_rows[yes_rows$log2FoldChange < -0.5, ]
#yes_rows <- yes_rows[yes_rows$VIRMA == "yes", ]
# Copy the relevant column (for example, a column called 'gene' or 'log2FoldChange') to clipboard
writeClipboard(na.omit(yes_rows$gene))  # Adjust 'gene' to whatever column you want to copy

```

```{r}
library(biomaRt)
# Define your sets
upregulated_genes <- res_df_switch$gene[res_df_switch$log2FoldChange > 0.5 & res_df_switch$padj < 0.05]  # Example cutoff



# Connect to Ensembl
all_genes <- read.table("data/gene_with_protein_product.txt", header = T)
all_genes <- all_genes$Gene

# Construct contingency table
#       | In target | Not in target
# ----------------------------------
# In upregulated       A     B
# Not in upregulated   C     D

A <- sum(upregulated_genes %in% VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x)
B <- sum(upregulated_genes %in% setdiff(all_genes, VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x))
C <- sum(setdiff(all_genes, upregulated_genes) %in% VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x)
D <- sum(setdiff(all_genes, upregulated_genes) %in% setdiff(all_genes, VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x))

contingency_table <- matrix(c(A, B, C, D), nrow = 2,
                            dimnames = list(
                              "Upregulated" = c("Yes", "No"),
                              "Target" = c("Yes", "No")
                            ))

print(contingency_table)

# Run Fisher's exact test
fisher.test(contingency_table)


downregulated_VIRMA_targets <- intersect(VIRMA_binding_RNAs$x, up_blastocyst)


A <- sum(upregulated_genes %in% downregulated_VIRMA_targets)
B <- sum(upregulated_genes %in% setdiff(all_genes, downregulated_VIRMA_targets))
C <- sum(setdiff(all_genes, upregulated_genes) %in% downregulated_VIRMA_targets)
D <- sum(setdiff(all_genes, upregulated_genes) %in% setdiff(all_genes, downregulated_VIRMA_targets))

contingency_table <- matrix(c(A, B, C, D), nrow = 2,
                            dimnames = list(
                              "Upregulated" = c("Yes", "No"),
                              "Target" = c("Yes", "No")
                            ))

print(contingency_table)

# Run Fisher's exact test
fisher.test(contingency_table, alternative = "greater")
```

```{r}
counts_control_Estradiol <- filtered_counts[,c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10)]

condition <- factor(c("Control", "Control", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol", "Estradiol"))

colData <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(counts_control_Estradiol))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_control_Estradiol, colData = colData, design = ~condition)
#dds <- DESeq(dds)


dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

# Order by adjusted p-value
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
#Add a column to label significance
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$significant <- ifelse(res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, "yes", "no")
res_df$VIRMA <- ifelse(rownames(res_df) %in% up_blastoid, "yes", "no")
res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$VIRMA), ]
res_df_significant_Estradiol_control <- res_df[res_df$significant == "yes",]
res_df_Estradiol_control <- res_df

# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = VIRMA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("no" = "grey", "yes" = "coral")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_point(data = res_df["VIRMA", , drop = FALSE], color = "cornflowerblue", size = 3)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, -0.5), col = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-log10(0.05)),  col = "grey")
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot", x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value")
  
  
  
# Filter rows where 'significant' column equals 'yes'
yes_rows <- res_df_significant_Estradiol_control[res_df_significant_Estradiol_control$significant == "yes", ]

# Copy the relevant column (for example, a column called 'gene' or 'log2FoldChange') to clipboard
writeClipboard(na.omit(yes_rows$gene))  # Adjust 'gene' to whatever column you want to copy

```

# TPM

```{r}
fpkmToTpm <- function(fpkm) {

exp(log(fpkm) - log(sum(fpkm)) + log(1e6))

}

feature_table_genes <- read.csv("data/Features_genes.csv")
feature_table_genes_2 <- as.data.frame(feature_table_genes$external_gene_name) #extract only gene names from file
colnames(feature_table_genes_2) <- "gene_name" 


#Add length to dataframe, and make it kbps
feature_table_genes_2$length <- (feature_table_genes$transcript_length/1000)  #transcript length is in bps
lengths_vector <- setNames(feature_table_genes_2$length, feature_table_genes_2$gene_name) # Create a named vector of lengths for quick lookup
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(filtered_counts), names(lengths_vector)) # Identify common IDs


# Subset data frame to common IDs and perform the transformation
tpm_data <- filtered_counts
tpm_data[common_ids,] <- tpm_data[common_ids,] / lengths_vector[common_ids]
tpm_data <- tpm_data[common_ids,]

#Normalize data for sequencing depth
for (i in 1:length(colnames(tpm_data))){
  sum_of_sample <- sum(tpm_data[,i])
  factor <- sum_of_sample/1000000 #Transform for transcripts per million
  tpm_data[,i] <- (tpm_data[,i]/factor)
  
}


tpm_data <- tpm_data[rowSums(tpm_data[, c(1:ncol(tpm_data))]) >5,]
```

```{r}
    )
  )

       x = "Condition",

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
VIRMA_targets <- read_csv("data/VIRMA_RNA_correct.csv", col_names = T)

VIRMA_hm
sum_VIRMA_control <- as.data.frame(rowSums(VIRMA_hm[, c(1:2)]))
sum_VIRMA_control <- rownames_to_column(sum_VIRMA_control, var = "gene")
sum_VIRMA_control <- sum_VIRMA_control[apply(sum_VIRMA_control, 1, function(row) all(row >= 1)), ]


sum_VIRMA_Estradiol <- as.data.frame(rowSums(VIRMA_hm[, c(3:10)]))
sum_VIRMA_Estradiol <- rownames_to_column(sum_VIRMA_Estradiol, var = "gene")
sum_VIRMA_Estradiol <- sum_VIRMA_Estradiol[apply(sum_VIRMA_Estradiol, 1, function(row) all(row >= 1)), ]

sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen <- as.data.frame(rowSums(VIRMA_hm[, c(11:18)]))
sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen <- rownames_to_column(sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen, var = "gene")
sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen <- sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen[apply(sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen, 1, function(row) all(row >= 1)), ]

sum_VIRMA <- inner_join(sum_VIRMA_control, sum_VIRMA_Estradiol)
sum_VIRMA <- inner_join(sum_VIRMA, sum_VIRMA_tamoxifen)

sum_VIRMA$Variable <- sum_VIRMA$`rowSums(VIRMA_hm[, c(3:10)])`/sum_VIRMA$`rowSums(VIRMA_hm[, c(11:18)])`
sum_VIRMA <- sum_VIRMA[order(sum_VIRMA$Variable, decreasing = TRUE),]
top_100_plus <- head(sum_VIRMA, 100)
top_100_min <- tail(sum_VIRMA, 100)
top_100_all <- rbind(top_100_plus, top_100_min)
```

```{r}

seurat_data <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_counts) 
seurat_data <- NormalizeData(seurat_data)
seurat_data <- FindVariableFeatures(object = seurat_data, nfeatures = 4000)
seurat_data <- ScaleData(seurat_data)
```

## Seq2Science

```{r}
sample_names <- (c("Control1", "Control2", "Estradiol10.1", "Estradiol10.2", "Estradiol20.1", "Estradiol20.2", "Estradiol40.1", "Estradiol40.2", "Estradiol80.1", "Estradiol80.2", "Tamoxifen10.1", "Tamoxifen10.2","Tamoxifen20.1", "Tamoxifen20.2","Tamoxifen40.1", "Tamoxifen40.2", "Tamoxifen80.1", "Tamoxifen80.2"))
filtered_counts_0 <- filtered_counts
filtered_counts_0[filtered_counts_0 == "NaN"] <- 0

for(i in unique(ref$condition)){
  for(j in unique(ref[ref$condition == i,]$concentration)){
    samples <- ref[ref$condition == i & ref$concentration == j, "sample"]
    p1 <- ggplot(filtered_counts_0, aes(.data[[samples[1]]], .data[[samples[2]]])) + 
      geom_point() +
      theme_bw() + 
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = paste0(i, " (", j, " ng/ul)" ),
           x = "Replicate 1 total", y = "Replicate 2 total") +
      geom_text(label = paste0("Rho = ", as.character(round(cor(filtered_counts_0[,samples[1]], 
                                           filtered_counts_0[,samples[2]]),3))),
                x = 0.9, y = 0.9, color = "red", size = 5) 
    
  plot(p1)
  }
}
```

```{r fig.width = 3, fig.height= 3}
pattern_high <- res_df_switch
pattern_high <- na.omit(pattern_high)
pattern_high <- pattern_high[, c("log2FoldChange", "gene", "VIRMA")]
pattern_high <- pattern_high[pattern_high$gene != "VIRMA", ]
head(pattern_high)


library(ggpubr)

# Create a violin plot with Wilcoxon test
ggplot(pattern_high, aes(x = VIRMA, y = log2FoldChange, fill = VIRMA)) +
  #geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +  # Violin plot with smooth density
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplot overlay for median
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format") +  # Wilcoxon test
  labs(title = "Violin Plot of log2FoldChange by VIRMA Status") +
  ylim(-1, 1)+
  theme_minimal()


# Run KS test
ks_test <- ks.test(
  pattern_high$log2FoldChange[pattern_high$VIRMA == "yes"],  # VIRMA targets
  pattern_high$log2FoldChange                                # All genes
)

# Plot with KS p-value annotation
ggplot(pattern_high, aes(x = log2FoldChange, fill = VIRMA)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "coral"))+
  labs(title = "VIRMA targets \n",
       x = "Log2FC", y = "Density") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("KS p = <0.01"),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 2, size = 4) +
  #ylim(0, 0.8)+
  xlim(-2, 2)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
# Assume your data frame is named 'df'
# and has columns 'log2FoldChange' and 'VIRMA' ("yes" or "no")

# Extract fold changes
virma_fc <- pattern_high$log2FoldChange[pattern_high$VIRMA == "yes"]
non_virma_fc_all <- pattern_high$log2FoldChange[pattern_high$VIRMA == "no"]

# Set up parameters
n_iterations <- 100
sample_size <- length(virma_fc)  # Same size as VIRMA group
p_values <- numeric(n_iterations)

# Resampling and testing
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
for (i in 1:n_iterations) {
  sampled_non_virma_fc <- sample(non_virma_fc_all, sample_size)
  test_result <- wilcox.test(
    virma_fc,
    sampled_non_virma_fc,
    alternative = "less"  # Test for downregulation
  )
  p_values[i] <- test_result$p.value
}

# Prepare data
pval_df <- data.frame(log_p = -log10(p_values))

# Plot
ggplot(pval_df, aes(x = log_p)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = -log10(0.05), y = Inf, label = "p = 0.05",
           vjust = -0.5, hjust = -0.1, angle = 90, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of -log10(p-values)",
       x = expression(-log[10](p-value)),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
